categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Fudan-Zhangjiang Bio-Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in innovative biopharmaceutical research and development, manufacturing, and marketing. Its main product lines include photodynamic therapy drugs for skin diseases and tumors, antibody-drug conjugates (ADC) for cancer treatment, and other patented or technically protected drugs. Key marketed products are photodynamic drugs for HPV-related skin diseases, tumor treatments, and drugs for vascular malformations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary gene engineering, photodynamic therapy, nanotechnology, and oral solid dosage form technology platforms. Its photodynamic technology is globally leading, focusing on selective activation of photosensitizers to treat diseases with minimal side effects. The ADC platform combines monoclonal antibodies with cytotoxic drugs for targeted cancer therapy. Manufacturing adheres to cGMP standards with advanced lipid nanoparticle encapsulation for drug delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves hospitals, clinics, and healthcare providers primarily in dermatology and oncology fields. Its products target patients with HPV infections, skin proliferative diseases, various tumors including breast cancer and lymphoma, and vascular malformations. The domestic Chinese market is the main revenue source, with ongoing efforts to expand internationally, especially in the US and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly concentrated in mainland China, with headquarters and production facilities in Shanghai and Taizhou. The company also has a presence in Hong Kong and is conducting clinical trials and registration efforts in the United States. Overseas assets constitute a small portion of total assets, indicating a primarily domestic focus with strategic international expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Fudan-Zhangjiang operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, encompassing drug research and development, manufacturing, and marketing. It produces active pharmaceutical ingredients and finished dosage forms, and distributes products through direct sales and contracted sales organizations (CSOs).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company strategically focuses on advancing photodynamic therapy and antibody-drug conjugates, aiming to maintain global leadership in photodynamic drugs and rapidly commercialize ADCs. It invests heavily in R&D, with a 44.29% R&D-to-revenue ratio in 2024, emphasizing clinical trials for new indications and international registrations. The pipeline includes expanded indications for existing drugs and novel compounds targeting oncology and dermatology.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sales of pharmaceutical products, including photodynamic drugs, anticancer nanomedicines, and other specialty pharmaceuticals. The company employs a distribution model combining direct sales and partnerships with CSOs for academic promotion. It also derives income from technology licensing and government subsidies related to R&D.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading innovator in photodynamic therapy globally and a competitive player in the ADC oncology drug segment. It holds a strong market position in China for photodynamic drugs and nanomedicines, with limited direct competition in its niche photodynamic products. Competitors include domestic and international pharmaceutical firms specializing in oncology and dermatology therapeutics.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 709 million, a 16.61% decrease from 2023, primarily due to sales transition issues with a key product. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 39.7 million, down 63.42% year-over-year, impacted by increased R&D expenses. The company maintains total assets of RMB 2.59 billion and net assets of RMB 2.3 billion, with a strong commitment to R&D investment and a stable workforce of 925 employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes innovative, clinically effective therapies addressing unmet medical needs, particularly in photodynamic therapy and targeted cancer treatments. Its photodynamic drugs offer superior safety, efficacy, and reduced recurrence rates compared to traditional therapies. The ADC platform provides targeted delivery of cytotoxic agents, enhancing treatment specificity and reducing side effects. The firm’s integrated R&D, manufacturing, and marketing capabilities enable rapid product development and commercialization, delivering differentiated value to patients and healthcare providers.
